data.text:
Now I understand the structure. Let me build the query following the plan:

1. Join order_items with products to get product_category_name (Portuguese)
2. Join with category_translation to get English category names
3. Filter for 'furniture_decor' category
4. Join with orders to filter out canceled/unavailable orders
5. Join with customers to get customer_unique_id
6. Count distinct customer_unique_id

args.purpose: Count distinct customers who bought furniture_decor items from non-canceled/non-unavailable orders
args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) as distinct_customers
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE ct.product_category_name_english = 'furniture_decor'
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
